title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-18
lineage: FOB Nak 700's > MAC > Nak Dragon > HHB cdr 800 > CDR > EAC > wav > SHN

ai_review.summary: Superb audience recording captures a high‑energy 4/18/82 show with smoking Bertha, stellar Promised Land and Let It Grow performances.
ai_review.review: The audience tape (AUD) delivers a lively, well‑balanced sound that lets the band’s fire shine through, despite a slightly hollow opening on Bertha and some mislabeled tracks. Musically the concert is a “X Factor” night – Jerry smokes from the first note, Bob drives a powerful Promised Land, Brent adds tasteful keyboard touches, Phil’s quake‑space shines, and the first set rolls with classics like Sugar Magnolia, Let It Grow and Big Railroad Blues.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars, praising performance and sound; recording is generally good with only minor flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear audience tape that captures live ambience; early Bertha sounds distant/hollow, track labeling errors cause confusion (Big Railroad Blues mislabeled), but overall clarity is strong.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set shines with tight playing and high energy; the show maintains momentum throughout, delivering a measured yet powerful performance that many fans call "X Factor".

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as 'smoking' from the opening Bertha, tasteful and at his best throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Phil: His ‘Quake Space’ is highlighted as a standout moment, showcasing powerful bass work.
band_member_comments.Bob: Nailed Promised Land with strong vocal/guitar presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboards) adds fine highlights on Promised Land and other songs.
